audit_item: A10 / reject non-string keys in ResearchArtifactStore manifests
finding: ResearchArtifactStore canonicalized the caller's L1 manifest without checking nested mapping keys. A nested integer key was silently converted to a JSON string; an integer key at the root leaked Python's mixed-key sorting TypeError.
change: The shared artifact canonicalizer recursively requires string dictionary keys in dictionaries and list/tuple values. L1 manifest serialization failures are normalized to ArtifactError before a completion record is committed.

red_regressions: Root integer key leaked TypeError from JSON sort_keys.
Nested integer key was silently coerced and accepted.

boundary: Only temporary synthetic artifact manifests were used; no project registry, persisted model bundle, market data, or formal evaluation record was accessed.
